verdict.rationale: Xero's first-party pages document creating branded invoices from templates and sending them, including via JAX plain-language commands. They also cover online payment through a Pay Now button and Stripe (cards, wallets, ACH), plus invoice tracking that alerts you the moment a customer opens an invoice. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that invoices show or notify paid status when a customer pays online, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing and testimonials.
